en.name: Chorizo, fresh
en.summary: Fresh chorizo is raw seasoned pork — usually the soft Mexican style, sold loose or in a thin casing and cooked before eating. It is not the hard Spanish cured sausage, and it keeps only 1–2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F).
en.pantry: Fresh chorizo does not keep at room temperature at all. The paprika and salt in it preserve nothing — the drying is what preserves a Spanish chorizo, and fresh chorizo has not been dried. Treat it as raw ground pork: the two-hour rule applies, and only one hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Bring a cool bag if the journey home is long.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below on the bottom shelf, on a tray, and cook it within 1–2 days of purchase. That is a short window even by raw-mince standards, because fresh chorizo is finely ground, heavily handled and often packed in vinegar and chilli that mask the early smell of spoilage. Keep it well away from anything ready to eat, use a separate board, and cook it right through until there is no pink and the fat has run.
en.freezer: It freezes for 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Portion it first — squeeze loose chorizo into flat, meal-sized bags, or wrap links individually — because you will not want to thaw a kilo to make one dish. Frozen food kept at −18 °C stays safe indefinitely; the months are about flavour, and the paprika oil fades and turns stale after that.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight, or in a sealed bag under cold running water, then cook immediately. Never on the counter. Do not refreeze chorizo that has thawed fully at room temperature — cook it instead.
spoilage: A sour or putrid smell under the paprika when the pack is opened.
A slimy or tacky surface on the casing or on loose meat.
Grey or greenish patches through the mince rather than on the surface only.
Liquid in the pack gone cloudy, ropy or foamy.
tips: Buy it on the day you plan to cook it; this one genuinely does not wait.
Freeze in flat, recipe-sized portions the day you buy it.
Check which chorizo you have — the dry cured kind keeps for months, this one does not.
Cook it first and drain the red fat if you want to use it in a dish without the grease.

faq.q: How long does fresh chorizo keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. It is raw sausage, not a cured one.
Yes, 1–2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze it flat in meal-sized portions on the day you buy it.

faq.q: Can you eat fresh chorizo raw?
faq.a: No. It is raw ground pork and must be cooked through. Only fully dry-cured chorizo is eaten as it is.

zh.name: 生西班牙臘腸
zh.summary: 生 chorizo 是調味過的生豬肉，常見的是墨西哥式的軟質版本，散裝或灌在薄腸衣裡販售，必須煮熟才能吃。它不是西班牙那種硬的風乾臘腸，冷藏 4 °C 以下只有 1～2 天，冷凍 −18 °C 下 1～2 個月。
zh.pantry: 生 chorizo 完全不能放常溫。裡面的紅椒粉和鹽起不了保存作用——真正保存西班牙臘腸的是「乾燥」，而生 chorizo 根本沒乾燥過。請把它當豬絞肉看待：2 小時原則適用，廚房超過 32 °C 時只有 1 小時。回家路程長的話請帶保冷袋。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下、冰箱最下層並墊托盤，購買後 1～2 天內煮掉。即使以生絞肉的標準來看這也算短，因為它絞得細、經手多，而且常泡在醋和辣椒裡，剛開始腐敗的氣味會被蓋掉。請遠離所有即食食品、用獨立砧板，並煮到完全沒有粉紅、油脂逼出為止。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下品質可維持 1～2 個月。先分裝再冷凍——散裝的壓成一份一餐的扁平袋，灌腸的一條一條包好——否則你會為了一道菜解凍一大包。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是風味：超過之後紅椒油會褪色、出現陳味。
zh.thawing: 冷藏隔夜解凍，或密封裝袋用冷水沖，之後立刻下鍋。不要放室溫退冰。若已在室溫下完全退冰，請直接煮熟，不要再冰回冷凍庫。
spoilage: 拆封時在紅椒香底下聞到酸敗或腐臭味。
腸衣或散裝肉表面發黏、摸起來黏手。
絞肉內部出現灰色或帶綠的區塊，不只是表面。
包裝裡的汁液變混濁、牽絲或起泡。
tips: 打算哪天煮就哪天買；這款真的等不得。
買回來當天就按一餐的份量壓平冷凍。
先確認你買的是哪一種——風乾的可以放好幾個月，這種不行。
先煎過並把紅色的油瀝掉，入菜就不會太油。

faq.q: 生 chorizo 冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下 1～2 天。它是生香腸，不是熟成臘腸。

faq.q: 生 chorizo 可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下 1～2 個月。買回來當天就按份量壓平冷凍。

faq.q: 生 chorizo 可以生吃嗎？
faq.a: 不行。它就是生豬絞肉，必須煮透。只有完全風乾熟成的 chorizo 才能直接吃。
